reuse.why: Adds the option to the existing getBulkBudgetCategories helper, and the template, #fixed and income exclusions stay where they already were.

duplication.why: No new copies are created; the same option-threading boilerplate is repeated in five signatures, and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own separate hidden check.

placement.why: The hidden rule changes inside the shared category query in actions.ts, which is where the tree keeps it.

scope.why: The diff only touches the helper, the action signatures and one focused test.

maintainability.why: The flag is simple, but copyPreviousMonth (a month-wide action with its own hidden/group_hidden check) does not get it, so the hidden rule still lives in two places and the feature behaves differently across actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every action the diff touches goes through getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth already had its own check before this change and was left alone.

disguised_duplication.where: Nothing is duplicated in disguise; the flag is added to the existing helper.
